description: Asked whether the weaver is in it, and saw the notch.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Judged the loaf, heard the plot, and approved a satire.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Named the shuttle, the beam, the reed, the thrum, and the bottom, and said three words he would not have written.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Asked, tied the knot, and refused to write the play or the letters.
name: William Shakespeare
